pr.title: Add mailbox signatures to the native API, REST API and panel
pr.body:
Adds mailbox signature administration to the native management boundary, REST GET/PATCH /api/v1/domains/{domainId}/accounts/{id}/signature, and the responsive panel. Administrators can enable/disable and edit plain-text and HTML formats; omitted settings and disabled formats are preserved.

Native commands share the existing owning-domain and protected-server-administrator checks. They reject wrong types, unknown fields, invalid UTF-8/control characters and more than 16,000 UTF-8 bytes per format before writes, then use existing persistence/cache invalidation. Signature contents stay out of basic mailbox views. No COM, web SQL, schema change, domain-signature management or mailbox-user self-service is added.

The panel edits HTML as inert textarea source, confirms active changes, checks field/request byte limits, submits changed fields, preserves existing CRLF source when toggling and writes plain-text edits with CRLF for the existing HTML fallback. It does not render or sanitize email markup. Existing domain override/append/local-mail/reply policy, macros, large-message limits and MIME behavior remain authoritative.

Validation: native and .NET builds passed. Disposable-VM tests passed 26 DNS + 152 HTTP/security + 2 HTTPS + 224 live native assertions (404 total), plus two separate pipe-identity assertions and browser workflows. Signature probes cover authorization, input/persistence/Unicode, no partial invalid writes, preserved behavior settings, plain/HTML/multipart SMTP-to-POP3 delivery, address macros and disable/cache invalidation, with only disposable local recipients. Browser coverage includes inert source, confirmations/cancellation, UTF-8/request limits, mobile layout and omission/line-ending preservation. The CRLF omission regression failed before the fix and passed afterward; final browser files were rerun successfully. Original VM state was restored, its original mail service verified running, and only original Ready checkpoints remain. No product runtime tests ran on the development host. All 83 local Markdown links and whitespace checks passed.

Updates README, ROADMAP, requirements, architecture, REST documentation, CI inventory, AGENTS and AI handoff. Records merged #39 and its verified baseline separately from this new head. Remaining advanced administration, DNS/DKIM, SpamAssassin packaging, certificate lifecycle, Defender, production hosting and PHP retirement stay planned.

CI passed on exact head `f9a94491d2f122fdf981aeb0be612136d2267dcd`: Release x64, all four database regression/management jobs, CodeQL, gcc/clang and installer publication. Every backend passed all 404 management assertions and expanded browser workflows. NUnit totals remained 1,315 per backend: Compact/MySQL/PostgreSQL passed 1,205 with 0 failures, 0 warnings, 34 inconclusive and 76 skipped; Express passed 1,206 with 75 skipped and the same other counts. Await maintainer review after this PR; no next item or phase starts without confirmation.

Add scoped mailbox signature controls to the native API and panel

Expose plain-text and HTML signature settings with strict native validation, shared domain and protected-target permissions, and inert source editing. Preserve unchanged formats and Windows line breaks, cover SMTP MIME delivery and browser safety, and synchronize roadmap, CI inventory and agent handoff.

issue.body:
Groups related Phase 1b administration into one larger delivery bundle, as requested, rather than one small setting per PR.

Adds native commands, REST routes and responsive panel controls for:
- Mailbox first/last names and read-only directory backing/recorded last-logon state.
- Domain catch-all, plus addressing and per-domain greylisting.
- Server-defined mailbox, alias and list counts (0 means unlimited).
- Domain plain-text/HTML signatures, fallback/replace/append policy and local-mail/reply switches.
- Alternate domain-name list/search/create/read/delete, active immediately with explicit confirmation.

Native authorization enforces owning-domain and protected-account boundaries. Object-limit changes and alternate-name writes require server administrator because they control resource allocation and global namespace. New catch-all writes require an active mailbox in the primary domain; signature/text/type/size/combined-setting validation finishes before persistence. Omitted settings and existing objects are retained. Existing business objects, parameterized persistence and native cache invalidation remain authoritative. Alternate-name creation also requires a newly assigned ID before reporting success because legacy persistence may return true after a failed insert. No schema, COM backend or web SQL is added.

The panel edits HTML as inert source, preserves omitted/unchanged settings and signature line endings, confirms catch-all/signature/alternate-name changes, and limits domain administrators to allowed controls. Names do not automatically provision DNS, certificates, DKIM or establish ownership. AD provisioning, mailbox-user self-service, queue/rules/routes/listener parity, DNS/DKIM lifecycle, SpamAssassin packaging, certificates, Defender and production/PHP cutover remain future work.

Validation: native and .NET compilation passed. In the checkpointed disposable VM, 26 DNS + 188 HTTP/security + 2 HTTPS + 312 live native assertions passed (528), plus 2 separate pipe-identity checks and browser workflows. New native tests cover roles/parents, profile/input/persistence, catch-all/plus routing/cache changes, active catch-all targets, limit enforcement/lowering/unlimited, alternate-name validation/collisions/local SMTP-to-POP3 delivery/removal, and domain signature replace/append/fallback/HTML/local/reply/disable behavior with profile macros. Browser checks cover forms, activation/removal confirmation and cancellation, changed-field preservation, inert source, role restrictions and mobile layout. Delivery probes use only disposable local mailboxes. The original VM was restored; its original mail service is running and only original Ready checkpoints remain. No product runtime execution occurred on the development host. All 84 local Markdown links and whitespace checks passed.

Updates README, ROADMAP, requirements, architecture, REST contract, CI inventory, AGENTS, AI handoff and working agreement. Records merged #40 and its baseline, and supersedes the tiny-slice planning estimate with the maintainer's larger-bundle preference while retaining VM/CI and per-PR review gates.

CI passed on exact head `34cfdfd1476cb64f1b55108b37a186f1b6087820`: Release x64, all four database regression/management jobs, CodeQL, gcc/clang and installer publication. Every backend passed all 528 management assertions and expanded browser workflows. NUnit totals stayed at 1,315 per backend: Compact/MySQL/PostgreSQL passed 1,205 with 0 failures, 0 warnings, 34 inconclusive and 76 skipped; Express passed 1,206 with 75 skipped and the same other counts. Await maintainer review after this PR; do not merge or start the next bundle without confirmation.
